subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customers, we are excited to inform you that we have added new payment options to make your shopping experience more convenient. You can now pay using Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal in addition to credit/debit cards. We hope this update will make your transactions smoother and hassle-free. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services!
